standard_name: Skeleton October 2026 Enterprise AI Implementation Standard

scope.rule: Every masterplan volume requires one current deep implementation dossier before enterprise qualification.

october_2026_non_negotiables: one canonical owner per production responsibility; shadow owners are defects
typed/versioned contracts and canonical parsing at trust boundaries
models propose; deterministic control planes authorize durable or privileged effects
principal, tenant, policy, budget, deadline and idempotency identity precede protected execution
authoritative, derived, cache and ephemeral state are explicitly separated
acknowledged durable writes require transactional/outbox or equivalent recovery semantics
untrusted model, retrieval, tool, file and external content never becomes policy or authority
all loops, retries, searches, delegation, concurrency, tokens, wall time and resource use are bounded
p95/p99, saturation, resource pressure and failure behavior accompany median performance claims
operation identity joins logs, metrics, traces, cost, model/tool/retrieval decisions and durable receipts
negative, adversarial, concurrency, crash, replay, saturation and recovery testing is mandatory
immutable release identity, provenance, migration preflight, canary and tested rollback are mandatory
operator controls use preflight, explicit admission, execution and immutable receipt
enterprise evidence is exact-head and expires on governed source, policy, contract, evaluator or operating-envelope change
complete enterprise AI requires all 421 volumes enterprise-qualified plus critical superiority and golden-journey evidence
qualification_rule: A volume cannot advance to enterprise_qualified or superior unless its dossier exists, all 14 levels are complete, masterplan fields match, evidence is exact-head/current, and the applicable enterprise superiority/golden-journey gates pass.
anti_shortcut: Implementation notes are obligations, not evidence. Prose, LOC, file existence, legacy implementation status, or self-scored benchmarks cannot promote enterprise grade.
